0.why: EightFace.cpp:249-345 branches on slotCvMode: :252 floors 0-10V onto a slot, :255 rounds 12 slots per volt in C4 mode and :256 reads channel 2 through slotC4Trigger as a retrigger, and every TRIG mode steps slotTrigger.process past 1V; no single range because the mode picks the law

1.why: EightFace.cpp:218 reads it with getVoltage and puts it through a SchmittTrigger at its default 1V threshold

comment: What the slot-selection input expects depends on the Slot CV mode: a trigger in the eight sequencing modes and in ARM, a 0 to 10V ramp across the slots in VOLT, and 1V per twelve slots in C4. In C4 mode a second channel on the same cable triggers the load, so there the jack reads two channels of a polyphonic cable; every other mode reads channel one alone.
